persona: Seasoned chartist / quant-leaning trader. Thinks in precise multi-condition setups: EMA/SMA crossovers with confirmation, MACD, RSI extremes & levels, bullish/bearish divergence, Bollinger/Keltner squeezes, multi-timeframe (daily/weekly/monthly), sequenced 'A then B' setups, price-return-over-window, volume spikes. Screens the whole market, combined and scoped by sector/country/market-cap size.

cases.question: Screen the whole US market for stocks where the 50-day SMA just crossed above the 200-day SMA (a golden cross) in the last 5 trading days, and the crossover is confirmed by price closing above both averages. I only want names above $2B market cap.
cases.goal: Fresh 50/200 SMA golden cross, recency-bounded to ~last week, confirmed by close above both MAs, US-only, mid/large-cap floor.
acceptance: Universe is US-listed equities only, market cap filtered to >$2B
Logic is 50-SMA crossing ABOVE 200-SMA (golden cross), not the inverse (death cross)
Recency window respected (~last 5 sessions), not any historical cross
Confirmation condition (close above both MAs) is applied, not ignored
Red flag if it returns oversold/RSI names or generic 'uptrend' stocks instead of the specific crossover
Red flag if it silently drops the market-cap or recency constraint

cases.question: หาหุ้นในตลาดไทยที่มี bullish divergence: ราคาทำ lower low แต่ RSI ทำ higher low บนกราฟรายวัน ช่วง 1-2 เดือนที่ผ่านมา เอาเฉพาะที่ volume วันล่าสุดสูงกว่าค่าเฉลี่ย 20 วันอย่างน้อย 1.5 เท่า
cases.goal: Daily bullish RSI divergence (price lower-low vs RSI higher-low) on Thai equities within recent ~1-2 months, plus a volume-spike confirmation (>1.5x 20d avg).
acceptance: Universe scoped to Thailand (SET/mai)
Divergence direction correct: BULLISH = price lower-low + RSI higher-low (not bearish, not plain oversold RSI)
Daily timeframe respected
Volume confirmation applied (latest volume >= 1.5x 20-day average)
Answer in Thai or clearly bilingual, acknowledges the divergence concept precisely
Red flag if it just returns low-RSI Thai stocks with no divergence structure

cases.question: Give me global names in a tight Bollinger Band squeeze — bands inside the Keltner Channels — that are ALSO showing rising volume over the last 10 sessions, suggesting the squeeze is about to resolve. Prefer tech/semiconductor sector.
cases.goal: Volatility squeeze (BB inside KC) as a pre-breakout setup, filtered by rising volume, sector-scoped to technology/semis, global universe.
acceptance: Correctly identifies the squeeze condition as Bollinger Bands contained within Keltner Channels (low volatility compression)
Applies a rising-volume filter over ~10 sessions
Scopes to tech / semiconductor sector
Global universe (not US-only) unless it explains a coverage limit
Red flag if it confuses squeeze with a simple low-ATR list and drops the BB-vs-KC relationship
Does not fabricate a directional call — squeeze is direction-agnostic until breakout

cases.question: I want a two-step setup on European large caps: first the stock dropped at least 15% over the past 20 trading days, THEN the daily MACD line crossed back above its signal line within the last 3 days. Basically capitulation followed by a momentum turn.
cases.goal: Sequenced 'A then B': a >=15% drawdown over ~20d FOLLOWED BY a fresh bullish MACD cross within last 3 sessions, Europe large-cap.
acceptance: Enforces ordering: the price drop happens BEFORE the MACD cross (sequence, not just co-occurrence)
Drop threshold correct (>=15% over ~20 sessions)
MACD signal is a bullish cross (MACD above signal) that is RECENT (~last 3 days)
Universe scoped to Europe, large-cap
Red flag if it returns names that only satisfy one leg, or ignores the temporal order
Red flag if MACD histogram/zero-line cross is substituted without noting the difference

cases.question: Screen for extreme overbought exhaustion: stocks where the WEEKLY RSI(14) is above 80 right now, across any global market. Rank them by how far above 80 they are.
cases.goal: Weekly-timeframe RSI(14) > 80 (extreme overbought) global screen, ranked by RSI level.
acceptance: Uses WEEKLY timeframe RSI, not daily
RSI period 14 and the 80 threshold both respected (not 70)
Global universe
Results ranked/sorted by RSI value (descending)
Red flag if it silently uses daily RSI or a 70 cutoff
Notes that overbought alone is not a short signal (context), without refusing the screen

cases.question: Find me quality growth names in a healthy pullback: 20% EPS growth and gross margin over 50%, but the stock has pulled back to near its 200-day EMA (within 3%) on the daily chart while daily RSI is between 40 and 50. US and China.
cases.goal: Fundamental quality (EPS growth 20%, GM>50%) combined with a technical buy-the-dip zone (price within 3% of 200-EMA, RSI 40-50 daily), US + China.
acceptance: Combines BOTH fundamental filters (EPS growth >=20%, gross margin >50%) and technical filters
Technical: price within ~3% of the 200-day EMA (proximity, not a cross) AND daily RSI in the 40-50 band
Universe = US and China only
Does not drop either the fundamental or the technical half
Red flag if RSI band is treated as oversold (<30) or if 200-EMA is swapped for 200-SMA without noting
Red flag if it returns pure-growth or pure-technical lists

cases.question: Show global small caps (under $1B) that are up more than 30% over the last month on above-average volume, but where the daily RSI is now flashing bearish divergence against the recent price high — I'm hunting momentum names that may be topping.
cases.goal: Strong 1-month momentum (>30%) on volume, small-cap, PLUS bearish RSI divergence (price higher-high vs RSI lower-high) as a topping warning.
acceptance: Market-cap filter: small-cap, under $1B
Return filter: >30% over ~1 month (~21 sessions)
Volume above average applied
Bearish divergence direction correct: price higher-high while RSI lower-high (not bullish, not plain overbought)
Global universe
Red flag if divergence is omitted and it just returns top monthly gainers

cases.question: Multi-timeframe trend alignment: I want stocks where price is above the 50-week SMA on the weekly AND above the 20-day EMA on the daily, with the daily MACD histogram positive. Japan and Korea, any cap. This is my trend-continuation long list.
cases.goal: MTF alignment — weekly above 50-SMA + daily above 20-EMA + daily MACD histogram positive, scoped to Japan + South Korea.
acceptance: Handles two timeframes simultaneously: weekly (>50-week SMA) and daily (>20-day EMA)
MACD histogram positive on the daily is applied
All three conditions ANDed (trend alignment), not OR
Universe scoped to Japan and South Korea
Red flag if it collapses everything to a single timeframe
Red flag if MACD histogram is confused with MACD line > signal without noting equivalence

cases.question: Simple one: which global stocks had their daily RSI(14) cross UP through 30 in the last two days? Classic oversold-bounce trigger. Prefer energy sector.
cases.goal: Fresh RSI(14) upward cross through 30 (oversold exit) within last 2 sessions, energy sector, global.
acceptance: Signal is a CROSS UP through 30 (RSI was <30, now >30), not merely RSI<30
RSI period 14, level 30, daily timeframe
Recency ~last 2 days respected
Energy sector scoping applied
Red flag if it returns a static oversold list (RSI still below 30) instead of the cross-up event

cases.question: หาหุ้นทั่วโลกในกลุ่ม healthcare ที่ราคายืนเหนือ 200-day SMA มาตลอด และล่าสุดเพิ่งเกิด monthly MACD bullish crossover — ผมอยากได้ setup แนวโน้มระยะยาวที่เพิ่งจะ turn บน timeframe รายเดือน คัดเฉพาะ market cap เกิน $5B
cases.goal: Long-term trend (price holding above 200-day SMA) with a fresh MONTHLY-timeframe MACD bullish cross, healthcare sector, global, large-cap (>$5B).
acceptance: Uses MONTHLY timeframe for the MACD bullish cross (not daily/weekly)
Requires price sustained above the 200-day SMA (established uptrend), not just a recent touch
Sector scoped to healthcare, global universe
Market-cap floor >$5B applied
MACD cross is bullish (MACD above signal), recent on the monthly frame
Answer acknowledges the monthly-timeframe request explicitly; red flag if it defaults to daily MACD
